verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official MCP server, bundled in the desktop app, that lets Claude, Cursor, Codex and other clients "drive Spline… straight into your open editor tab". Its built-in AI Agent also creates and edits scenes and Hana screens through the editor, so agent-driven creation and modification is clearly supported. The Code API only changes object properties at runtime in exported scenes, and probes found no OpenAPI or REST write API. missing for 10: documented list of MCP write tools/operations, headless or browser MCP access (it is desktop-only and needs an open editor tab), a REST/file-level write API, independent hands-on corroboration.
